title: Prescribed Force Trajectories as Benchmarks for Longitudinal EMG Decoding: Reproducibility Archive
description: Prospective reproducibility repair for Prescribed Force Trajectories as Benchmarks for Longitudinal EMG Decoding. Includes the executable force-only temporal prior, a newly specified independent EMG reconstruction with declared numerical assumptions and synthetic tests, frozen historical summary tables, manuscript LaTeX source, and four original figure PDFs. The new EMG implementation has not been run on the entire source dataset or independently reconciled against historical reported values.
